target_id.description: Target the report covers. In a multi-target report (mixed_targets true) this holds the first target in sorted order; target_ids lists all of them.

target_ids.description: All targets covered, sorted ascending. Present only in multi-target reports (mixed_targets true).

mixed_targets.description: True when the report covers more than one target (opted in with --allow-mixed-targets). Single-target reports omit this field.

template.description: Platform template the report was rendered with (generic reports omit this field).

groups.description: Findings grouped by asset_id (generic reports only; platform-template JSON omits this field). Groups are ordered by asset_id ascending; findings inside a group by severity then finding_id. The flat findings array carries the same findings in grouped order. In a multi-target report each group also carries its target_id, and groups are ordered by target_id ascending then asset_id ascending.

target_id.description: Target this group belongs to. Present only in multi-target reports.
